name: Rotating Fireball Manager
description: Manages the rotation of fireballs in the game.
InternalName: ファイアーバー（マネージャー）

fields.name: Number of Flames on Each Side
fields.description: The number of flames that appear on each side of the rotating fireball.

fields.name: Start Position
fields.description: The starting position for the rotation of the fireballs.

fields.name: Use Actor Position
fields.description: Uses the actor's exact position as the rotation center when enabled. Otherwise, uses the center of the tile the actor occupies.

fields.name: Rotation Speed
fields.description: Sets the rotation speed of the fireballs.

fields.name: Change of Direction by Variable X
fields.description: Indicates if the direction of the fireballs changes based on a variable.
